The '''Umbaran airbase''' was a base used by the [[Umbaran militia]] and their [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] allies during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]] sent a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to hijack a [[Umbaran hover tank/Legends|Umbaran hover tank]] and destroy four [[Umbaran mobile heavy cannon/Legends|Umbaran mobile heavy cannons]], who were firing on a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fleet commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]].
